description: Self-contained synthetic test-document regression set. These cases validate the evaluator, not production model quality.

cases.question: How early should I request paid time off?

sources.content: Submit paid time off requests at least five business days before the first day off. Managers respond within two business days.

cases.expected_answer: Submit the request at least five business days in advance. Managers respond within two business days.

cases.question: How many unused paid time off days carry over?

sources.content: Employees may roll over up to five unused paid time off days. Rolled days expire on March 31 of the following year.

cases.expected_answer: Up to five unused days roll over, and they expire on March 31 of the following year.

cases.question: What is the monthly wellness stipend and when are receipts due?

sources.content: Full-time employees receive a $50 monthly wellness stipend. Submit receipts to payroll by the fifth calendar day of the next month.

cases.expected_answer: The stipend is $50 per month. Receipts are due to payroll by the fifth calendar day of the next month.

cases.question: How long is parental leave, and when should HR be notified?

sources.content: Eligible employees receive twelve weeks of parental leave. Notify Human Resources at least thirty calendar days before the planned leave when possible.

cases.expected_answer: Eligible employees receive twelve weeks of parental leave and should notify HR at least thirty calendar days beforehand when possible.

cases.question: How far ahead should domestic travel be booked?

sources.content: Book domestic travel at least fourteen calendar days before departure. Standard bookings must use economy class.

cases.expected_answer: Book at least fourteen calendar days before departure and use economy class.

cases.question: What is the standard nightly hotel limit?

sources.content: The standard hotel limit is $220 per night before taxes. A higher rate requires written approval from the department director before booking.

cases.expected_answer: The standard limit is $220 per night before taxes. Higher rates need prior written director approval.

cases.question: What daily meal allowance can I claim?

sources.content: Employees traveling overnight may claim a meal allowance of up to $65 per travel day. Alcohol is not reimbursable.

cases.expected_answer: The meal allowance is up to $65 per overnight travel day. Alcohol is not reimbursable.

cases.question: When must I submit a travel expense report, and which receipts are required?

sources.content: Submit an itemized expense report within ten business days after returning. Attach receipts for individual expenses over $25.

cases.expected_answer: Submit the itemized report within ten business days of returning and attach receipts for expenses over $25.

cases.question: What authentication is required for VPN access?

sources.content: Multi-factor authentication is required for every VPN login. Use the company authenticator app or an approved hardware security key.

cases.expected_answer: Every VPN login requires MFA through the company authenticator app or an approved hardware key.

cases.question: What should I do if a company device is lost?

sources.content: Report a lost company device to IT within one hour. IT will revoke its access and initiate a remote lock or wipe.

cases.expected_answer: Report it to IT within one hour so access can be revoked and the device remotely locked or wiped.

cases.question: What are the password length and reuse rules?

sources.content: Passwords must be at least fourteen characters. Do not reuse any of your previous ten passwords.

cases.expected_answer: Passwords must contain at least fourteen characters and cannot reuse any of the previous ten passwords.

cases.question: How quickly should a suspected phishing message be reported?

sources.content: Report suspected phishing to the Security team within thirty minutes using the Report Phishing button. Do not click links or open attachments.

cases.expected_answer: Report it to Security within thirty minutes using the Report Phishing button; do not click links or open attachments.
